name: Levi J. Hargrove
title: Professor of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation; Professor of Biomedical Engineering (by courtesy)
department: Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation; Biomedical Engineering by courtesy
fitReason: Substantive applied ML and physical-assistive robotics fit: learned intent, gait and controller prediction, embedded inference and human-in-the-loop evaluation. A computational or bench-focused contribution is more plausible to scope tightly than promising access to clinical trials in a short visit.

physicalEvidence.summary: The full April 2025 revision of Deep-Learning Control of Lower-Limb Exoskeletons verifies learned gait-feature and command prediction on an ExoMotus-X2. TensorFlow Lite inference updates references at about 50 Hz for a 333 Hz ROS/C++ torque controller; two healthy participants outside the training dataset performed treadmill and stair tests. This is closed-loop learned physical assistance. The separate March 2026 Synthetic Therapist paper trains on previously collected patient–therapist data and validates ROS inference on live exoskeleton streams, but explicitly leaves actual patient training with the new learned therapist for future work. Do not turn its offline patient validation into an eight-patient prospective deployment. The study is collaborative: first author Vianello is identified with Pons Lab, and this record does not establish independent Hargrove-directed apparatus or visitor access.

shortVisit.summary: The Neural Engineering lab’s People page offers a general contact route for joining the team, without specifying external master’s visitors, duration, summer availability or support. No applicable short-visit invitation was verified. Recreational-therapy internship advertisements are a different discipline/program and are not used.

The experiments are in the Northwestern–Shirley Ryan AbilityLab research setting. The actual host/employer, location, laboratory onboarding and immigration sponsor must be established; Northwestern visitor rules must not automatically be transferred to the hospital.

The saved Northwestern policy review found conflicting graduate/undergraduate wording for Student Intern and a doctoral-only Visiting Predoctoral Fellow title. Any external-master appointment still needs school/OISS approval.

Patient contact, clinical privileges, human-subject access and research-data access are not implied by faculty willingness. A short project would need appropriate approvals and a feasible nonclinical or already-approved scope.
Current Engineering and Feinberg directory headers say Professor; an older Feinberg biography paragraph still says Associate Professor. This record follows the current directory headings.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
